title: HelpDesk Version 2.6.2 Update
summary: HelpDesk Version 2.6.2 keeps the funny Watching status and fixes the HelpDesk update announcement so it can post in #server-logs while non-ticket logs remain filtered.
added: Added a deployment update guard so official HelpDesk update messages can post to #server-logs.
Kept the bot activity text: Watching staff forget to claim tickets.
changed: Deployment announcements are now allowed even with ticket-only server log filtering enabled.
Regular non-ticket server logs remain filtered out of #server-logs.
Existing ticket controls, reply controls, support ban controls, and Founder/Admin access remain unchanged.
